{{samename|longer volumes published in Japan and Singapore|List of Pokémon Adventures XY volumes}}
Beginning in December 2014, [[VIZ Media]] began releasing volumes of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]], using the title "Pokémon XY" and advertised as a "Pokémon Adventures special edition". As the chapters of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}} had not yet begun release in [[List of Pokémon Adventures volumes|collected volume format]] in Japan, these releases are compiled directly from the original magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures. Despite this, they have no connection to the [[List of Pokémon Adventures XY volumes|similar mini-volume releases]] in Japan. Instead the amount of chapters from each of the Japanese mini-volume releases are published in two separate, smaller releases consisting of three to four chapters each for the Viz Media releases. The series concluded when the twelfth and final volume was published on October 3, 2017.
